items: AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 9.5): Approves ₦1.2Tn Draft 2027 Budget, Realigns 2026 Budget to ₦1.1Tn & Sets Up 369-Ward Solar Water Projects
KANO STATE (PSI 9.3): Presents ₦1.107Tn 2027 Budget (63% Capital) to Assembly & Pledges NTA Kano Golden Jubilee Support
FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.2): Completes Landmark Apo-Karshi Road, Previews 12 Major Inaugurations & Establishes Youth/Women Secretariats
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.9): Approves 25% CONLESS for Legislative Staff as South-East First & Announces 10 Digital Court Halls
KWARA STATE (PSI 8.8): Breaks Ground on K-Wara 50,000L/Day Dairy Hub & Inspects Landmark Oluremi Tinubu Hospital
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Otu Dissolves Task Force Over Illegal Demolition, Enforces HIV Anti-Discrimination & Reverses Irregular Payroll
OYO STATE (PSI 8.6): Pays ₦5.35Bn Circular Road Compensation, Presents ₦1.115Tn 2027 Budget & Swears in Permanent Secretaries
EDO STATE (PSI 8.5): Summons Oil Firms on CSR, Hosts NDLEA Boss Marwa on Drug War & Launches Anti-Bullying School Campaign
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.4): Swears in 5 High Court Judges & Allocates 49 Duplexes to Judicial Officers at Kobape Estate
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.3): LASRRA Partners NIMC on School NIN Registration, Confirms State Auditor-General & Supports 542 Eko Cares Beneficiaries
NIGER STATE (PSI 8.2): Disburses Interest-Free 'FarmerMoni' Loans to 600 Farmers Across 25 LGAs Under New Niger Agenda
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.0): Launches Remote BPO Workforce Initiative in Jos to Drive Youth Employment
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.9): Reaffirms Strategic Commitment to STEM Education & Celebrates National Award-Winning Science Students
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.8): Commissions Ugbo Odogwu Smart Green School, Advancing 268-School Infrastructure Agenda
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.7): Partners UNICEF on SBC Youth Summit, Earns Federal Praise for Orphanage & Appoints Health Perm Sec
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Sule Inspects Upgraded NBS Broadcast Facilities & Tomatoes Market Road Project in Lafia
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.4): Sets Nov 25 & 27 Pilgrims Departure Dates & Honours Retiring Agriculture Officials
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 7.3): Honours Grassroots Workers at LG Service Week & Clears 4-Year Inherited Gratuity Arrears
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.2): Reviews Solar Water Upgrade Projects & Drafts Integrated Water Billing System

AKWA IBOM (PSI 9.5): Gov. Umo Eno presided over the State Executive Council, approving a draft 2027 budget of ₦1.2tn (₦768.7bn capital) and a revised 2026 supplementary budget of ₦1.1tn. Council also approved solar-powered water projects across all 369 wards and celebrated Flamingos star Mary Akpan.

KANO (PSI 9.3): Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf presented a proposed ₦1.107tn 2027 'Budget of Consolidating Gains and Accelerated Rural Development' (63% capital allocation) to the House of Assembly; Deputy Gov. Murtala Garo pledged support for NTA Kano's 50th anniversary.

FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.2): FCT Minister Nyesom Wike inspected the completed Apo-Karshi road, proposing accelerated commissioning before month-end among 10-12 major presidential project inaugurations, and highlighted the historic creation of dedicated Youth and Women Secretariats.

ABIA (PSI 8.9): Gov. Alex Otti approved 25% CONLESS for House of Assembly staff (first in South-East) starting Jan 2027, and announced at the NBA-SPIDEL conference the upcoming commissioning of 10 digitalized court halls equipped with solar power and broadband.

KWARA (PSI 8.8): Gov. AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq performed the groundbreaking for K-Wara (targeting 50,000 litres of dairy daily, reaching 25,000 farmers and 1,500 youth jobs) and inspected the advanced Oluremi Tinubu Hospital in Ilorin ahead of commissioning.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.7): Gov. Bassey Otu dissolved the State Planning Task Force over an arbitrary property demolition, ordering compensation; NACA/CR-SACA pushed HIV anti-discrimination law enforcement; and State Auditors reversed irregular promotion payroll payments.

OYO (PSI 8.6): Gov. Seyi Makinde paid ₦5.35bn compensation to 578 Circular Road property owners, presented the ₦1.115tn 2027 budget to the Assembly, swore in four Permanent Secretaries, honored public servants, and highlighted AfCFTA trade leadership.

EDO (PSI 8.5): Edo Oil Ministry cross-examined Pan Ocean and New Cross over host community development commitments; NDLEA Chairman Marwa commended Edo's drug war leadership; and the First Lady's Office launched an anti-bullying campaign across public schools.

OGUN (PSI 8.4): Ogun State Government swore in 5 new High Court judges, allocated 49 newly constructed duplexes to all state High Court judges at Kobape Estate, commenced construction on an Appeal Court complex, and highlighted 31,000 e-affidavits processed.

LAGOS (PSI 8.3): LASRRA signed an MoU with NIMC to streamline NIN enrolment for school admissions, the Assembly confirmed Dr. Olufunke Tayo-Makanjuola as substantive Auditor-General, and the state distributed financial assistance to 542 Eko Cares beneficiaries.

NIGER (PSI 8.2): Gov. Umaru Bago's administration flagged off digital enumeration and training for LGA desk officers to disburse interest-free FarmerMoni loans under RH-GEEP 3.0 to 600 smallholder farmers across all 25 LGAs.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.0): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang's administration launched the pilot phase of a Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) initiative in Jos, recruiting tech-savvy graduates for global remote work opportunities.

RIVERS (PSI 7.9): Gov. Siminalayi Fubara's administration, via SSG Dr. Dagogo Wokoma, reaffirmed its commitment to STEM education during a visit by the Science Teachers Association of Nigeria (STAN), celebrating national exhibition awardees.

ENUGU (PSI 7.8): Gov. Peter Mbah's administration commissioned the Ugbo Odogwu Smart Green School in Trans Ekulu, Enugu, as part of the state's rollout of 268 technology-enabled basic education schools across all wards.

ZAMFARA (PSI 7.7): Zamfara Ministry of Information and UNICEF hosted day two of the Youth Summit on Social and Behaviour Change; Federal Ministry of Women Affairs praised the Gusau Orphanage upgrade; and new Health Perm Sec Guraguri assumed duty.

NASARAWA (PSI 7.6): Gov. Abdullahi Sule conducted on-the-spot inspections of upgraded broadcast infrastructure at Nasarawa Broadcasting Service (NBS) and ongoing construction of the Tomatoes Market Road in Lafia.

ADAMAWA (PSI 7.4): Adamawa Christian Pilgrims Board announced Nov 25 and 27 airlift dates for Israel; Ministry of Agriculture held a send-forth ceremony for four retiring directors and senior officers.

ANAMBRA (PSI 7.3): Gov. Chukwuma Soludo addressed the 2026 Local Government Service Week, highlighting the clearance of 4 years of inherited gratuity arrears, agricultural initiatives, and plans to reconstitute the LG Service Commission.

GOMBE (PSI 7.2): Gombe Water Resources Commissioner held an interactive session with the Water Board on Dadinkowa solar plant upgrades, pipeline repairs, and a draft Integrated Water Billing System presentation.
